plan.title: 0.129.x upgrade rewrites .deft/GENERATION.json without the integer `generation`, which deft-core-guard then rejects

narratives.Description: OVPR fix plan group G-B (story id ovpr-g-generation), unit P2-U4, issues #6012 and #5835. Every upgrade or repair rewrites `.deft/GENERATION.json` without its `generation` key, dropping the only defence against old global CLIs (AC10.9) and turning leftover `deft-core-guard` CI red. Keep the key on every rewrite (U4a), delete a managed `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml` on upgrade and tell the user to drop the required check (U4b), and remove the dead guard emitter and the docs that teach it (U4c). One PR.
narratives.Overview:
Found on 0.129.1 (0.127.0 -> 0.129.1 upgrade).

**What happens.** `directive upgrade` rewrites `.deft/GENERATION.json` (runtime version, managed-section fingerprints, a new retained entry) but drops the top-level `"generation": N` key (it was 12). The `deft-core-guard` workflow (`no-mixed-core-and-app`) requires an integer `generation` strictly greater than the base's, so the upgrade PR fails it, and the automated reviewer flagged the missing key as P1.

**Workaround.** Append `"generation": N+1` by hand (13 here).

**Impact.** Every upgrade PR in a repo that runs the guard needs a hand edit to a generated file, and nothing in the upgrade output says so.

**Suggested fix.** Have the upgrade write `generation` (incremented) when it rewrites the file, or relax the guard to the shape the installer produces. Related: #3378 (guard rejecting the installer's own file set).
narratives.UserStory: As a developer upgrading a converted Directive project, I want `GENERATION.json` to keep its generation number and the retired deft-core-guard workflow to be removed, so that my upgrade PR is not red and old global CLIs still refuse to overwrite my repo.
narratives.StoryId: ovpr-g-generation (carried in the file name so the ordered plan can match it; plan.id stays the id minted from the issue, because the brief tools refuse a different plan.id)
narratives.UnitSpec: ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/units/P2-U4-generation-key-kept-and-retired-core-guard-removed.md (read in full). groups.md G-B: one PR (U4a + U4b + U4c together).
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
U4a (#6012, AC10.9):
1. packages/core/src/install-health/ownership.ts `writeOwnershipRecord`: when `options.generation` is undefined, read `readEvidenceGenerationNumber(projectRoot)` and, if >= 1, write it as `payload.generation`. Keep the 'already current' early return and keep `generation` out of `stableOwnershipFingerprint`. Conversion still raises it (setup.ts unchanged there).
U4b (#5835 consumer half):
2. packages/runtime/src/removal-steps/steps.ts: add `removeRetiredCoreGuardWorkflow(root)`: delete `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml` only when it is a regular file containing `name: deft-core-guard`; otherwise keep it and return a notice naming it.
3. Call it from runtime setup when `operation === "upgrade"` (any `from`) and add it to every convert strategy in removal-steps/strategies.ts. Not from automatic setup or doctor.
4. packages/cli/src/plan-present.ts: plan line 'remove retired `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml`' when the file exists; success line 'Removed the retired deft-core-guard workflow. If `deft-core-guard` is a required status check in branch protection, remove it there, or this PR cannot merge.' when it was removed.
5. packages/runtime/src/installer-output-inventory.ts: `core-guard-workflow` stays `na-retired-copy-model`, justification cites the removal step.
U4c (#5835 remainder):
6. Delete `ensureCoreGuardWorkflow` and its builders from init-deposit/scaffold.ts and drop it from `depositNeutralization`; delete core-guard-pin-content.ts and its test; remove the core-guard parts of hygiene.ts and refresh.ts (`skipGuardWorkflow`); remove `evaluateGenerationMonotonicVsBase` and its messages from freshness/generation-gate.ts if only tests use them.
7. Scrub current docs: content/UPGRADING.md, content/commands.md, content/docs/consumer-check-contract.md, content/docs/freshness-contract.md, content/scm/github.md; SPECIFICATION.md via its xbrief source if it is rendered. Leave CHANGELOG.md, the OVPR requirements and the ledger as history.
8. Tests per the spec (ownership.test.ts, setup.test.ts, removal-steps.test.ts, upgrade-bookend / plan-present tests; delete the emitter tests). No grep-only guard tests (groups.md).
9. Changelog fragment changelog.d/6012-generation-kept-core-guard-removed.md.
narratives.Constraint:
- Do not raise `generation` on ordinary upgrades or repairs (AC10.9: conversion only).
- Do not relax or patch the guard to accept the installer's file set; the guard is retired (#5835 Locked).
- Do not reintroduce any mixed-commit `.deft/core` CI guard.
- Do not delete a workflow that lacks `name: deft-core-guard`, or any other workflow.
- Do not delete the guard from automatic setup or doctor (AC8.6 / AC12.1).
- Do not edit Scott's policy files (packages/core/src/policy/branch-sync.ts, policy/sync-default.ts, packages/runtime/src/scm-sync-default.ts); list them for Scott in the PR instead.
- Decisions per spec defaults: repos that already lost the key are accepted as-is (say so in the changelog); repair does not delete the guard (upgrade only, as locked).
- OVPR change gate: read ~/Projects/directive-ovpr-planning-202611/OVPR-CHANGE-GATE.md. Do not edit docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/ and do not ship behaviour that departs from the written OVPR requirements or architecture; stop that part and hand back a change proposal.
- Changelog: add the changelog.d fragment named in file_scope; never edit CHANGELOG.md.
narratives.Dependencies: Depends on: none. Blocks: none. Inside the PR, U4c follows U4b.
narratives.PlanningOrder: design-critique: not warranted, because the OVPR fix plan and its unit specs already decide the design (polfer decisions D-001, D-008, D-037)

items.title: After converting a legacy repo with `generation: N`, `GENERATION.json` has `generation: N+1`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a legacy `.deft/GENERATION.json` with `generation: 12`, when conversion setup runs, then the rewritten file has `generation: 13`.

items.title: After any later `directive upgrade`, `directive install --repair` or automatic setup, `generation` is still N+1.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a converted project with `generation: 13`, when `runSetup` runs with `operation: "upgrade"` and a different runtime version, or with `operation: "repair"`, then the rewritten `GENERATION.json` still has `generation: 13`; and an explicit `{ generation: 14 }` option still wins in `writeOwnershipRecord`.

items.title: Running setup twice on an in-sync checkout does not rewrite `GENERATION.json`.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an in-sync checkout, when setup runs a second time with identical inputs, then `GENERATION.json` is not rewritten (AC8.2, AC13.2).

items.title: `directive upgrade` on a repo with a managed `deft-core-guard.yml` deletes it; the plan announces it and the result says to remove the required check if one is configured.

narrative.Acceptance: Given `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml` containing `name: deft-core-guard`, when `directive upgrade` runs, then the plan lists 'remove retired `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml`', the file is deleted, and the success output says to remove the `deft-core-guard` required status check from branch protection.

items.title: A workflow at that path without `name: deft-core-guard` is not deleted, and the output names it.

narrative.Acceptance: Given `.github/workflows/deft-core-guard.yml` without the `name: deft-core-guard` line, when `directive upgrade` runs, then the file is kept and the output names it as looking user-edited.

items.title: No install, upgrade or repair path can create or refresh `deft-core-guard.yml`; the emitter code is gone.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the changed tree, when packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts and refresh.ts are read, then `ensureCoreGuardWorkflow` and its builders and core-guard-pin-content.ts no longer exist and no setup path writes `deft-core-guard.yml`.

items.title: Current docs no longer teach landing a deposit PR so deft-core-guard passes.

narrative.Acceptance: Given content/ (excluding CHANGELOG.md), when `git grep -i core-guard -- content ':!CHANGELOG.md'` is run, then no hit instructs landing a deposit PR so deft-core-guard passes or describes the guard as live protection.

items.title: The inventory entry `core-guard-workflow` stays `na-retired-copy-model` with a justification that matches the removed emitter and the removal step.

narrative.Acceptance: Given packages/runtime/src/installer-output-inventory.ts, when the `core-guard-workflow` entry is read, then its status is `na-retired-copy-model` and its justification cites the upgrade removal step.
